import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')
    n, k = map(int, data[0].split())
    nums = list(map(int, data[1].split()))
    out=[]
    # Your code here — compute the max of every window of size k
    for i in range(n-k+1):
        m=nums[i:k]
        j=max(m)

        out.append(j)
        k+=1
    p=""    
    for i in out:
        p+=str(i)+" "
    print(p)    



main()
